members.doc:
Initiates mesh generation for this study.
The study must support mesh generation and must not already have an up-to-date mesh.
Mesh generation must not already be in progress and no other job may be in progress
for this study.
Returns a MeshFuture object that can be used to monitor the mesh generation operation,
or null if mesh generation could not be initiated.
members.name: generateMesh

members.doc:
Opens the results viewer for this study, transitioning the Simulation workspace
into the Results environment.
The study must be the active study; call activate() first if it is not (check isActive).
The study must also have results available; check resultState first (it should be
UpToDateResultState or OutOfDateResultState).
This uses the modern results viewer, which is a preview capability that may be disabled
by product configuration; where it is not available the call returns false (the legacy
results viewer is not supported).
Returns false if the study is not active, no results are available, the modern results
viewer is not available, or the viewer could not be opened.
Currently only Linear Static Stress studies are supported.
Returns true if the results viewer was successfully opened, false otherwise.
members.name: showResults

members.doc:
Closes the results viewer for this study, returning the Simulation workspace to the
setup environment. This is the counterpart to showResults().
The call is idempotent: if the results viewer is not currently open, it returns true.
Returns true if the results viewer is no longer open after the call (including when it
was not open to begin with), false if it could not be closed.
members.name: exitResults

members.doc: Returns the material assignments for all bodies in the study.
members.name: materialAssignments

members.doc: Gets the current state of this study's solve results.
members.name: resultState

members.doc: Gets the core Material object for this assignment (override if present, otherwise the model material).
members.name: material

members.doc:
Reverts this material to the original design model material, removing any study-specific override.
This is a no-op if already using the model material.
Returns true if the material was successfully reverted or was already the model material.
members.name: revertToModelMaterial

members.doc:
Assigns a new material to the body associated with this MaterialAssignment, overriding any current material assignment.
The material can be from a material library or a document material.
material : The material to assign.
Returns true if the material was successfully assigned.
members.name: assignMaterial

members.doc: Indicates whether the original design material was used or the material is overridden by the study.
members.name: isModelMaterial

members.doc:
Gets whether the assigned material is valid for this study type.
A value of false indicates that material values are out of limits and simulation cannot be performed.
members.name: isMaterialValid
